catalog.desc: Make a statement before anyone even reaches your front door. The Minneapolis Grand Urn is our flagship planter — a tall, commanding piece handcrafted from cement that anchors entryways, driveways, and garden beds with timeless elegance. Built to handle the toughest Midwestern winters and the heat of a Southern summer, this urn is as durable as it is beautiful. Whether you fill it with seasonal blooms, ornamental grasses, or year-round evergreens, the Grand Urn turns any yard into a destination.
catalog.name: Minneapolis Grand Urn
catalog.tagline: Flagship planter — tall, commanding, built for entryways.

catalog.desc: Wide, bold, and built to impress — the Twin Cities Pedestal Urn brings serious curb appeal to any outdoor space. With its generous planting depth and broad rim, this urn is ideal for large floral arrangements, dramatic centerpiece plantings, or ornamental topiaries. Place a pair flanking your front steps or driveway entrance for a look that's nothing short of grand. Every Pedestal Urn is handcrafted to order and built to last through every season.
catalog.name: Twin Cities Pedestal Urn
catalog.tagline: Wide, bold — ideal for flanking front steps or a driveway entrance.

catalog.desc:
The Boulevard Urn is where handcrafted artistry meets sheer presence. With a sweeping 23-inch outer diameter, a generous 17-inch planting basin, and standing 17 inches tall, this is a planter designed to anchor a space — not simply occupy it. At approximately 170 pounds of solid, hand-poured concrete, The Boulevard Urn isn't going anywhere. Neither is the impression it makes.
Inspired by the grand, tree-lined boulevards of America's most iconic neighborhoods, this urn brings that same sense of timeless elegance to your front entry, driveway, patio, or garden. Whether flanking a walkway in pairs or standing alone as a centerpiece, The Boulevard Urn transforms any outdoor space into something worth slowing down for.
catalog.name: The Boulevard Urn
catalog.tagline: Statement piece with sweeping presence — anchors any outdoor space.

catalog.desc:
Some things are built to last a season. The Heritage Urn is built to last a lifetime.
Handcrafted in Minneapolis from premium Portland cement, the Heritage is a mid-size classic urn that brings old-world character to any outdoor space. Its timeless silhouette draws from traditional European garden design — the kind of craftsmanship that once took generations to master and is rarely seen in today’s mass-produced market.
Solid, substantial, and beautifully proportioned, the Heritage looks equally at home flanking a front entry, anchoring a patio corner, or standing as a quiet centerpiece in a garden bed. Plant it full with seasonal color or let it stand on its own — either way, it commands attention without demanding it.
Every Heritage Urn is cast by hand, one at a time, right here in the Twin Cities. No two are exactly alike. That’s not a flaw — that’s the point.
Features
Handcrafted from premium Portland cement
Mid-size classic proportions — versatile placement
Timeless old-world design aesthetic
Built for year-round outdoor durability
Made in Minneapolis, Minnesota

catalog.desc: A symbol of protection, power, and prestige. Rooted in centuries of Asian architectural tradition, our hand-poured cement Foo Dog brings that same sense of strength and ceremony to your front door, driveway, or garden. Each piece is poured individually.

catalog.desc: Steeped in tradition and rich in detail, the Dynasty Lantern brings calm sophistication to any garden, pathway, or outdoor living space. Its substantial weight keeps it grounded through wind and weather, while its sculpted form adds visual interest from every angle.
catalog.name: The Dynasty Lantern
catalog.tagline: Classic Asian stone lantern — pairs with any landscape.

catalog.desc: A compact statement piece that punches well above its weight. Place it at the base of a planter, along a garden path, on a front step, or as part of a larger decorative vignette. Lightweight enough to reposition easily but solid enough to weather the elements.

catalog.tagline: Regal and richly detailed — our most versatile yard accent.

catalog.desc:
Inspired by the grandeur of Regency-era estate gardens, the Regency Medallion Urn is a striking centerpiece that commands attention from the moment it’s placed. Hand-cast in durable cement and finished in a rich Antique Bronze, this urn features an elegant fluted rim, decorative medallion panels around the bowl, and a beautifully ribbed pedestal base — all hallmarks of timeless classical design.
At 17 inches tall and 17 inches wide, this urn strikes the perfect balance between bold presence and versatile placement. Set it solo on a front stoop, pair two flanking a driveway entrance, or use it as a garden focal point — the Regency Medallion Urn elevates any outdoor space with old-world sophistication.
Built to last through Minnesota winters and summer sun alike, this piece is as enduring as it is beautiful.


Availability	Local pickup (Minneapolis) or nationwide shipping

•	Flanking driveways and walkways in pairs
•	Garden focal points and patio accents

process.subtitle: Most pieces are in the ground within six weeks of the first visit. Larger monoliths and full garden installs take longer; you'll know by week one.

steps.d: Kurt comes to your yard. Measures, looks at the house, talks about light and grade. Sketch on-site.
Pick your piece from the yard or commission a pour. Choose numerals, font, LED color and scene.
Hand-cast in-studio. Concrete cures for 30 days before finish work begins — paint, stain, seal.
We dig, level, set, and wire to a low-voltage transformer. Photocell included. Landscape restored.

about.title: Concrete, Cast By Hand.
paragraphs:
Hello, neighbor — and welcome to our little corner of the Twin Cities.
We are Twin City Concrete Yard & Garden, a Minneapolis-area business built on a simple idea: your outdoor space deserves more than mass-produced plastic and fading resin. We handcraft and carry durable, character-rich concrete pieces — planters, urns, garden statues, yard art, and seasonal accents — designed to grow more beautiful with every Minnesota season that passes.
Whether you’re sprucing up a front entry, anchoring a backyard garden, or searching for a gift that will last a lifetime, we’re here to help you find exactly the right piece. Come visit us, browse our yard, and let’s bring your outdoor space to life.



What We Offer
Our yard is stocked with a wide and rotating assortment of concrete pieces for every style, space, and budget:

🪴	Planters & Urns
From petite windowsill pots to grand urn pairs perfect for a front porch or garden gate — classic, cottage, and contemporary styles for every taste.
🦋	Garden Statues
Animals, angels, birds, wildlife, and whimsical figures. Each statue is cast with fine detail and finished to stand up to our harsh winters and warm summers.

🌸	Yard Art & Accents
Birdbaths, stepping stones, garden benches, and decorative borders — the finishing touches that tie your outdoor space together with style and intention.

🎁	Seasonal & Gift Items
Rotating seasonal selections and gift-ready pieces perfect for housewarmings, garden lovers, and anyone who appreciates something made to last.



Our Vision
We started Twin City Concrete Yard & Garden with one goal in mind: to give Minneapolis-area homeowners access to the kind of beautiful, lasting outdoor pieces that used to require a specialty trip downtown or an expensive custom order.
We believe your yard is an extension of your home — a place where family gathers, neighbors pause, and seasons are celebrated. The right planter, the right statue, the right birdbath doesn’t just decorate a space; it anchors it. It gives it a soul.
That’s why every piece we carry is chosen for its quality, its character, and its ability to age gracefully. Concrete, when it’s done right, doesn’t fade or crack in the cold — it develops a beautiful patina, a story worth telling.
Our vision is simple: to be the place you think of first when you want to make your outdoor space feel like yours. We’re a family business, and we treat every customer like a neighbor — because in this city, you just might be.

“Come see us — your garden is waiting for its centerpiece.”
With warmth,
The Family at Twin City Concrete Yard & Garden
Minneapolis, Minnesota
